description: Multi-turn batch scenario: create 8+ rules + dashboard + channel in one flow. Tests large multi-entity workflow.

turns.user: I run a large supermarket with 4 zones: dairy, produce, frozen, and bakery. Each zone has a temperature sensor, HVAC, and door sensor. Food-safety rules require continuous temperature monitoring with alerts.
Good plan. Per food-safety standards: dairy and produce below 5°C, frozen below -18°C. Create temperature alert rules for each zone, and alert if a door stays open over 30 seconds.

Are the rules done? Also build me a dashboard called 'Store Overview' grouping all temperatures by zone. Route alerts to a webhook channel for store-manager with URL https://example.com/store-webhook.
Just build it all — create everything. No need to confirm again.

per_turn: T2: create temp + door rules per zone
expectations.overall: 完整分区监控方案落地：≥8条规则(每区至少2条) + 分区仪表盘 + 通知频道。应发现 3 个预置异常(dairy-temp-02超温/produce-hvac停机/frozen-door门开)。
